svg.text: Confident blue. A cyan path. Calm, readable surfaces.
Inter / system sans · readable and direct
Use the full navy wordmark on light surfaces; use the icon with light text on navy.
Keep logo proportions and clear space. Never recolor or stretch the artwork.
Use blue for actions, cyan for accents, and labeled green / amber / red for status.
Body 16 px · controls 14 px · page headings 32 px · spacing in multiples of 4 px.
Implementation: web/style.css • Usage and contrast: docs/BRAND.md
